tools.name: get_mileage_rate
tools.description: The IRS standard mileage rate in force on one day, in dollars per mile, with the period it covers and whether it is published or provisional.

tools.name: list_mileage_rates
tools.description: Every published IRS standard mileage rate period this service holds, newest first. Leave out purpose for all of them.

tools.name: calculate_deduction
tools.description: The standard mileage amount for miles driven, each entry priced by the IRS rate on its own date. For a whole year, give one entry per month or per drive: in a year like 2026 the rate changed on 1 July.

tools.name: mileage_log_requirements
tools.description: What the IRS asks a mileage log to contain (Publication 463): the details for each drive and each year, what is not deductible, and the standard-rate rules.
